note: Part of the spike reader's identity (hashed into readers_entry as a code file). Golden hashes and any confidence threshold are only valid under exactly these settings. At ORT_ENABLE_BASIC the QDQ int8 model is NOT executed with int8 kernels: DequantizeLinear feeds fp32 MatMul and all convs are fp32 (MLAS sgemm/conv), so int8 here means int8-stored weights with simulated quantisation, and VNNI/AMX int8 paths never run. EXTENDED/ALL fuse to QLinearMatMul etc. and give different logits bytes.
